SUPERSET_WORKER_DONE task: widgets-12

- **summary:** The bot's summary on 4c1e9a2 does not say "No open findings remain": its last
  finding, "Treat plugin text as untrusted data" (loader.js:580), is still open. Bot runs
  on a1b2c3d, b2c3d4e and 4c1e9a2 all passed; the earlier run on 9f8e7d6 failed as a run,
  not a finding. That finding asks for a strict format instead of prose, or tool limits
  outside the prompt. I didn't do either: a plugin is a prose file by jane's contract,
  and tool limits belong to the agent harness. The full reason is in the thread. A human
  reviewer should decide whether that is enough. Everything else is fixed with tests:
    - only plugins in plugins.csv or the current repo load, and others are never cloned;
    - each plugin is printed as data under a plugin_rule= line, framed with its repo, commit
    and a per-run token;
    - PLG-001 rejects every YAML spelling the loader reads differently;
    - the README PLG-001 row lists ask.
- **files:** src/loader/loader.js, src/loader/README.md, docs/ask.md, docs/lifecycle.md,
  packages/validate/src/utils/plugins.ts, packages/validate/src/validators/plugins.ts,
  packages/validate/README.md, plus tests: loader.test.cjs, validators/plugins.test.ts,
  lifecycle.test.ts.
- **checks:**
    - yarn build passes.
    - Vitest 464/464.
    - lint has the 2 known errors.
    - test:scripts 358/360: the same 2 tests fail on the base branch, and #11 on main
    fixes them.
- **proof:** https://pages.example.com/acme/widgets-12-proof/ (v3, verified publish, with live
  runs of the guard). The link is in the PR body.
- **handoff:**
    - Head is 4c1e9a2. I pushed 5 commits with no force; a1b2c3d is an empty commit to rerun
    the bot, because the re-run API returned 404.
    - Threads answered: 3/3 original, plus 2 new ones from the bot; 4 resolved by the bot, 1
    open with my reply.
    - I removed a stale index.lock (from 03:30, no git process running) that was blocking
    commits.
    - Status comment edited, and .boss-worker/notes.md updated.
